name: anudeep-khadi-bandar-billing
description: feat(db-core): advanced end-to-end Supabase Cloud communication architecture with live bi-directional sync across all entities
releaseNotes: 1. Direct Supabase Cloud query and upsert unified across Invoices, Products, Receivers, Consignees, and Settings. 2. saveFromBill immediately synchronizes new party records directly to Supabase cloud table. 3. Eliminated fallback polling collisions that caused state overwrites. 4. Real-time WebSocket subscriptions active for instant cross-device updates.
